title: AuroraPay — Next-Gen Fintech Platform
summary: Complete brand overhaul and ultra-fast web dashboard for a global cross-border payments protocol handling millions in daily volume.
challenge: AuroraPay needed to transition from an outdated legacy portal into a high-trust, sleek digital platform that loads under 500ms globally while maintaining rigorous security UI design.
solution: We re-engineered their web stack using Next.js App Router, edge functions, and tailored dark-mode UI components featuring subtle glassmorphism and real-time transaction graphs.

title: LuxeWear — D2C Fashion Experience
summary: Immersive e-commerce store with interactive 3D product try-ons, custom checkout funnels, and fluid editorial layouts.
challenge: High cart abandonment rates and slow mobile page performance were suppressing conversion for their premium apparel line.
solution: Built a headless Shopify storefront using Next.js, Lenis inertia scrolling, micro-interactions, and instant 1-click checkout integration.

title: Synapse AI — Enterprise Automation Portal
summary: AI document parser and automated workflow engine for enterprise logistics operations processing 50,000+ invoices daily.
challenge: Manual invoice data entry caused costly delays and errors across 12 regional warehouses.
solution: Designed and deployed custom AI extraction pipelines integrated with an interactive React control room dashboard and automated WhatsApp notification bot.
